column1: # One row per narration segment, in order. Tab-separated. '#' comments and blank lines ignored.
# seg
# in    seconds to seek into the clip before the segment starts (skips page load / layout shift)
# speed playback multiplier. Never above 1 in this cut: agent-browser only emits a frame when
#       pixels change, so a clip of a mostly-still page is shorter than its wall time and has to be
#       stretched to cover its narration. assemble.py refuses to build a segment whose narration
#       outruns its clip, so a shortfall shows up as a build failure and not as a frozen frame.
# crop  documentation only — the camera treatment in treatments.tsv is what the assembler applies.
# chip  burnt-in label, or '-'. Nothing is sped up in this cut, so nothing carries a speed chip.
# seg02 and seg06-seg10 are the split-screen blocks; their left-pane crop lives in treatments.tsv
# as the `sp` phase, and must match the 1120x1080 left pane's shape or the build refuses it.
# seg09 plays clip09_split, a two-scene left pane re-cut from the clip09 masters: the ranked blast
# radius, then a hard cut to the DataHub page carrying the write-backs. One fixed crop could not
# have framed both, and re-shooting was not an option.
